subclasses.name: Path of the Wild Heart
subclasses.summary: Walk in Community with the Animal World
subclasses.description: Barbarians on this path see themselves as kin to beasts. Their Rage calls on the strength of a bear, the speed of an eagle or the teamwork of a wolf.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: You can cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals, but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.description:
Each time you start your Rage, pick one animal. Its gift lasts while the Rage lasts.

Bear. You have Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant.

Eagle. When you start the Rage you can take the Dash and Disengage actions as part of that Bonus Action. While raging you can take one of them as a Bonus Action.

Wolf. Your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.description:
Pick one gift. You can change it after a Long Rest.

Owl. You gain Darkvision 60 feet, or 60 more feet if you already have it.

Panther. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

Salmon. You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.description: You can cast Commune with Nature, but only as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.description:
Each time you start your Rage, pick one more gift. It lasts while the Rage lasts.

Falcon. While you wear no armor you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

Lion. Enemies within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you or another barbarian with this gift.

Ram. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can knock it Prone.

subclasses.name: Path of the World Tree
subclasses.summary: Trace the Roots and Branches of the Multiverse
subclasses.description: These barbarians draw on the cosmic tree that links the planes. Their Rage shields friends with life and pulls enemies close.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.description:
Vitality Surge. When you start your Rage you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level.

Life-Giving Force. At the start of each of your turns while raging, you can pick another creature within 10 feet of you. It gains Temporary Hit Points: roll as many d6s as your Rage Damage bonus and add them up. They vanish when your Rage ends.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: While raging, when a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction. It makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus). On a failure you teleport it to an empty space within 5 feet of you, or as close as you can, and its Speed is 0 until the end of that turn.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.description: On your turn, your reach is 10 feet longer with melee weapons that have the Heavy or Versatile property. When you hit with such a weapon you can use the Push or Topple mastery, on top of the weapon's own mastery.

features.name: Travel along the Tree
features.description: When you start your Rage, and as a Bonus Action while raging, you can teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see. Once per Rage you can teleport up to 150 feet instead and bring up to six willing creatures within 10 feet of you, each landing within 10 feet of where you arrive.

subclasses.name: Path of the Zealot
subclasses.summary: Rage in Ecstatic Union with a God
subclasses.description: Zealots are filled with the power of a god. Their fury deals holy or deathly damage and keeps them on their feet.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: While raging, the first creature you hit on each of your turns with a weapon or Unarmed Strike takes extra damage: 1d6 plus half your Barbarian level, rounded down. Pick Necrotic or Radiant each time.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: You have a pool of d12s for healing: four at level 3, five at level 6, six at level 12 and seven at level 17. As a Bonus Action, spend any number of them, roll them and regain that many Hit Points. The pool refills after a Long Rest.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Once per Rage, when you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus. You must use the new roll.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you let out a battle cry. Up to ten creatures of your choice within 60 feet have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. Once per Long Rest, or spend one use of Rage to do it again.

features.name: Rage of the Gods
features.description: When you start your Rage you can take on a divine form for 1 minute or until you have 0 Hit Points. You fly at your Speed and can hover, you have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage, and when a creature within 30 feet would drop to 0 Hit Points you can take a Reaction and spend a use of Rage to set its Hit Points to your Barbarian level instead. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 3+ spell slot to do it again.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.summary: Master Sophisticated Battle Maneuvers
subclasses.description: Battle Masters turn training into tricks. They spend superiority dice on maneuvers that trip, push, rally and outwit.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: You learn three maneuvers and have four superiority dice, which are d8s. A maneuver spends one die unless it says otherwise; spent dice come back after a Short or Long Rest. You learn two more maneuvers at levels 7, 10 and 15, and gain a fifth die at level 7 and a sixth at level 15. Maneuver saving throws use DC 8 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus. When you learn new maneuvers you can also swap one you know.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice and one skill of your choice from the Fighter skill list.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: As a Bonus Action, study a creature you can see within 30 feet. You learn its Immunities, Resistances and Vulnerabilities. Once per Long Rest, or spend a superiority die to do it again.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.description: Your superiority dice become d10s.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, you can roll a d8 and use it instead of spending a superiority die.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
features.description: Your superiority dice become d12s.

Combat Superiority.description: Pick the maneuvers you know. Each one spends a superiority die.

options.name: Ambush
options.description: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, spend a die and add it to the roll (not while Incapacitated).

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.description: On your turn, spend a die and 5 feet of movement to swap places with a willing creature within 5 feet. One of you adds the die to AC until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.description: When you take the Attack action, give up one attack and use a Bonus Action. An ally who can see or hear you can use its Reaction to make one attack and adds the die to its damage.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.description: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion) check, spend a die and add it to the roll.

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.description: When you hit, spend a die and add it to the damage. The target makes a Strength save or drops one object you choose that it holds.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.description: When you hit, spend a die and add it to the damage. The next attack against the target by someone other than you has Advantage, if made before the start of your next turn.

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a die and take the Disengage action. Add the die to your AC until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a die to feint at a creature within 5 feet. Your next attack against it this turn has Advantage and adds the die to damage on a hit.

options.name: Goading Attack
options.description: When you hit, spend a die and add it to the damage. The target makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 5 feet in a straight line before hitting with a melee attack this turn, add the die to the damage.

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.description: When you hit, spend a die and add it to the damage. An ally who can see or hear you can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.description: When you hit, spend a die and add it to the damage. The target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Parry
options.description: When a melee attack damages you, take a Reaction and spend a die. Reduce the damage by the die roll plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier.

options.name: Precision Attack
options.description: When you miss with an attack roll, spend a die and add it to the roll. It can turn the miss into a hit.

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.description: When you hit, spend a die and add it to the damage. A Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

options.name: Rally
options.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a die. An ally who can see or hear you gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the die roll plus half your Fighter level.

options.name: Riposte
options.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, take a Reaction and spend a die to make one melee attack against it. Add the die to the damage on a hit.

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.description: When you hit with a melee attack, spend a die. Pick another creature within 5 feet of the target and within your reach: if the original attack roll would hit it, it takes damage equal to the die roll.

options.name: Tactical Assessment
options.description: When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check, spend a die and add it to the roll.

options.name: Trip Attack
options.description: When you hit, spend a die and add it to the damage. A Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or falls Prone.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.summary: Support Combat Skills with Arcane Magic
subclasses.description: Eldritch Knights mix weapon training with wizard magic: shields and blasts between sword swings.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Wizard spells, with Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. You know two Wizard cantrips (three at level 10) and prepare three level 1 Wizard spells. The number of prepared spells grows as you level, up to 13 at level 20, and you can swap one prepared spell each time you gain a Fighter level. Your spell slots follow the Eldritch Knight table: two level 1 slots at level 3, up to level 4 slots at level 19.

features.name: War Bond
features.description: Over a 1-hour ritual during a Short or Long Rest, you bond with a weapon. You can't be disarmed of it unless you are Incapacitated, and as a Bonus Action you can call it to your hand from anywhere on the same plane. You can bond with two weapons; a third replaces one of them.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of the attacks with casting one of your Wizard cantrips that takes an action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you use Action Surge, you can also teleport up to 30 feet to an empty space you can see, before or after the extra action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace two of the attacks with casting one of your level 1 or 2 Wizard spells that takes an action.

subclasses.name: Psi Warrior
subclasses.summary: Augment Physical Might with Psionic Power
subclasses.description: Psi Warriors fight with mind as well as muscle: telekinetic shields, mental strikes and flying leaps.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description:
Your Psionic Energy dice: four d6s at level 3, six d8s at level 5, eight d8s at level 9, eight d10s at level 11, ten d10s at level 13 and twelve d12s at level 17. You regain one spent die after a Short Rest and all of them after a Long Rest.

Protective Field. When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, take a Reaction and spend a die: reduce the damage by the roll plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).

Psionic Strike. Once per turn, right after you hit a creature within 30 feet with an attack, spend a die: it takes extra Force damage equal to the roll plus your Intelligence modifier.

Telekinetic Movement. As a Magic action, move a Large or smaller object, or a willing creature other than you, up to 30 feet. Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a die to do it again.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description:
Psi-Powered Leap. As a Bonus Action, gain a Fly Speed equal to twice your Speed until the end of the turn. Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a die to do it again.

Telekinetic Thrust. When you deal damage with Psionic Strike, the target makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Intelligence modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or you knock it Prone or push it up to 10 feet.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage. If you start your turn Charmed or Frightened, you can spend a die to end every such effect on you.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: As a Bonus Action, pick up to as many creatures as your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) within 30 feet, you included. They have Half Cover for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated. Once per Long Rest, or spend a die to do it again.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: You can cast Telekinesis without a spell slot or components, with Intelligence as the ability. While you concentrate on it, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action on each of your turns. Once per Long Rest, or spend a die to do it again.

subclasses.name: Warrior of Mercy
subclasses.summary: Manipulate Forces of Life and Death
subclasses.description: Warriors of Mercy heal with one hand and harm with the other, ending suffering one way or another.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can spend 1 Focus Point to deal extra Necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature: it regains Hit Points equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. When you use Flurry of Blows, you can swap one of its strikes for this healing without spending the Focus Point.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills and with the Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.description: Hand of Harm also leaves the target Poisoned until the end of your next turn. Hand of Healing also ends one of these conditions on the creature: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can swap each strike for Hand of Healing without spending Focus Points. Once per turn you can also use Hand of Harm with a Flurry strike without spending a Focus Point; you can do that a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.description: As a Magic action, touch a creature that died in the last 24 hours and spend 5 Focus Points. It comes back to life with Hit Points equal to 4d10 plus your Wisdom modifier, and the conditions listed in Physician's Touch end on it. Once per Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Warrior of Shadow
subclasses.summary: Harness Shadow Power for Stealth and Subterfuge
subclasses.description: Warriors of Shadow move through darkness, step from shadow to shadow and strike unseen.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description:
Darkness. Spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness without components. You can see inside it, and while it lasts you can move it 60 feet at the start of each of your turns.

Darkvision. You gain Darkvision 60 feet, or 60 more feet if you already have it.

Shadowy Figments. You know the Minor Illusion cantrip, with Wisdom as the ability.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, as a Bonus Action you can teleport up to 60 feet to an empty space you can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. You then have Advantage on the next melee attack you make before the end of the turn.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.description: You can spend 1 Focus Point when you use Shadow Step to ignore its light requirement for both spaces. Right after teleporting you can also make one Unarmed Strike as part of the same Bonus Action.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: As a Magic action while in Dim Light or Darkness, spend 3 Focus Points. For 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated or until you end your turn in Bright Light, you are Invisible, you can move through occupied spaces as Difficult Terrain, and Flurry of Blows costs no Focus Points.

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Elements
subclasses.summary: Wield Strikes and Bursts of Elemental Power
subclasses.description: Warriors of the Elements wrap their fists in fire, frost, lightning and wind, reaching and shoving foes from afar.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: At the start of your turn, spend 1 Focus Point to attune for 10 minutes or until you are Incapacitated. While attuned your Unarmed Strikes reach 10 feet farther, can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage instead of their usual type, and on a hit you can force a Strength save (your Focus save DC) to push or pull the target up to 10 feet.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.description: You know the Elementalism cantrip, with Wisdom as the ability.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 2 Focus Points to make a 20-foot-radius Sphere of energy at a point within 120 feet. Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Focus save DC, taking three rolls of your Martial Arts die of that type on a failure, or half on a success.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.description: While Elemental Attunement is active, you have a Fly Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.description:
While Elemental Attunement is active you gain more:

Damage Resistance. At the start of each turn, pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder: you have Resistance to it until your next turn.

Destructive Stride. When you use Step of the Wind, your Speed rises by 20 feet, and creatures you pass within 5 feet of can take one roll of your Martial Arts die of a chosen element (once per creature per turn).

Empowered Strikes. Once per turn, when you hit with an Unarmed Strike, add one roll of your Martial Arts die of the same type.

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster
subclasses.summary: Enhance Stealth with Arcane Spells
subclasses.description: Arcane Tricksters add wizard magic to their bag of tricks: an invisible mage hand, illusions and stolen spells.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Wizard spells, with Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. You know Mage Hand and two other Wizard cantrips (four in total at level 10) and prepare three level 1 Wizard spells. The number of prepared spells grows as you level, up to 13 at level 20, and you can swap one each time you gain a Rogue level. Your spell slots follow the Arcane Trickster table: two level 1 slots at level 3, up to level 4 slots at level 19.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: When you cast Mage Hand you can make the hand Invisible, and you can control it as a Bonus Action. With it you can make Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks, for example to pick a lock or a pocket, from up to 30 feet away.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: If you have the Invisible condition when you cast a spell on a creature, it has Disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell on that turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: When you use the Trip option of Cunning Strike, you can also aim it at a second creature within 5 feet of your Mage Hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: Right after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area, take a Reaction. It makes a saving throw with its spellcasting ability against your spell save DC. On a failure the spell has no effect on you, and if it is level 1 or higher and a level you can cast, you know it for 8 hours while the caster can't cast it. Once per Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.summary: Practice the Grim Art of Death
subclasses.description: Assassins strike first and hardest. Disguises and poison help them get close.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. During the first round of a fight, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet, and when your Sneak Attack hits in that round the target takes extra damage equal to your Rogue level.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.description: You gain a Disguise Kit and a Poisoner's Kit and proficiency with both.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description:
Masterful Mimicry. After hearing someone speak or seeing their handwriting for at least 1 minute, you can copy it. Others need a Wisdom (Insight) check against your Dexterity (Deception) check to spot the fake.

Roving Aim. Your Speed isn't reduced to 0 by using Steady Aim.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.description: When you use the Poison option of Cunning Strike, the target also takes 2d6 Poison damage whether or not it succeeds on the save. This damage ignores Resistance to Poison.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: When you hit with Sneak Attack in the first round of a fight, the target makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus). On a failure the attack's damage is doubled.

subclasses.name: Soulknife
subclasses.summary: Strike Foes with Psionic Blades
subclasses.description: Soulknives form blades of pure thought, talk mind to mind and slip into minds to stun.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description:
Your Psionic Energy dice: four d6s at level 3, six d8s at level 5, eight d8s at level 9, eight d10s at level 11, ten d10s at level 13 and twelve d12s at level 17. You regain one spent die after a Short Rest and all of them after a Long Rest.

Psi-Bolstered Knack. When you fail an ability check that uses a skill or tool you're proficient with, roll one die and add it. The die is spent only if the check then succeeds.

Psychic Whispers. As a Magic action, pick up to as many creatures as your Proficiency Bonus within sight. Roll one die: for that many hours you can speak to each other mind to mind within 1 mile. The first use after a Long Rest is free; after that it spends the die.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: When you take the Attack action or make an Opportunity Attack, you can make a psychic blade in your free hand for the attack. It is a Simple Melee weapon with Finesse and Thrown (range 60/120 feet) and the Vex mastery, dealing 1d6 Psychic damage plus your ability modifier. Right after attacking with it, you can make a second blade as a Bonus Action to attack again, dealing 1d4 Psychic damage plus your ability modifier.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description:
Homing Strikes. When an attack with your psychic blade misses, roll one die and add it to the attack roll. The die is spent only if the attack then hits.

Psychic Teleportation. As a Bonus Action, spend a die and throw a blade at an empty space you can see up to 10 times the roll in feet away. You teleport there.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: As a Magic action, you become Invisible for 1 hour or until you dismiss it. It ends early on you right after you deal damage to a creature or make one make a saving throw. Once per Long Rest, or spend a die to do it again.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage with a psychic blade, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or is Stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once per Long Rest, or spend three dice to do it again.

subclasses.name: College of Dance
subclasses.summary: Move in Harmony with the Cosmos
subclasses.description: Dance bards fight with footwork. Their steps turn Bardic Inspiration into strikes and help friends move around the battlefield.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.description:
While you wear no armor and hold no Shield, you gain these benefits.

Dance Virtuoso. You have Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks that involve dancing.

Unarmored Defense. Your AC is 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier.

Agile Strikes. When you spend a use of Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, Bonus Action or Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of it.

Bardic Damage. Your Unarmed Strikes can use Dexterity for the attack roll. Their damage is one roll of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Dexterity modifier, as Bludgeoning damage. This roll does not spend a use.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction and spend a use of Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed. One ally within 30 feet of you can then use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed. Neither move provokes Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.description: When you roll Initiative and are not Incapacitated, you can spend a use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll the die: you and each ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you add the number to Initiative.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure. Creatures within 5 feet of you making the same save get this benefit too. Not while you are Incapacitated.

subclasses.name: College of Glamour
subclasses.summary: Weave Beguiling Fey Magic
subclasses.description: Glamour bards learned their art from the fey. Their magic charms, frightens and fills allies with fresh courage.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.description: You always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared. Right after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a spell slot, you can make a creature you can see within 60 feet make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure it is Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Once per Long Rest, or spend a use of Bardic Inspiration to do it again.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a use of Bardic Inspiration and roll the die. Pick a number of creatures within 60 feet up to your Charisma modifier (at least one). Each gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the roll, and can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: You always have Command prepared. As a Bonus Action you cast Command without a spell slot and take on an unearthly majesty for 1 minute (Concentration). While it lasts you can cast Command as a Bonus Action without a slot, and a creature Charmed by you fails its save against it automatically. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 3+ spell slot to do it again.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action, take on a majestic presence for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated. The first time a creature hits you with an attack roll on a turn, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or the attack misses instead. Once per Short or Long Rest.

subclasses.name: College of Valor
subclasses.summary: Sing the Deeds of Ancient Heroes
subclasses.description: Valor bards fight on the front line. Their songs make allies hit harder and dodge better, and they mix spells with weapon swings.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description:
A creature holding one of your Bardic Inspiration dice can use it in one of these ways.

Defense. When an attack roll hits it, it can take a Reaction, roll the die and add it to its AC against that attack. This can turn the hit into a miss.

Offense. Right after it hits with an attack roll, it can roll the die and add it to the damage.

features.name: Martial Training
features.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields. You can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a Spellcasting Focus for your Bard spells.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action on your turn. You can cast one of your cantrips that takes an action in place of one of those attacks.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: After you cast a spell that takes an action, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

subclasses.name: Light Domain
subclasses.summary: Bring Light to Banish Darkness
subclasses.description: Light clerics serve gods of the sun and truth. They burn enemies with radiant fire and blind attackers with sudden flashes.

features.name: Light Domain Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray and See Invisibility at level 3; Daylight and Fireball at level 5; Arcane Eye and Wall of Fire at level 7; Flame Strike and Scrying at level 9.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: As a Magic action, spend a use of Channel Divinity. Magical Darkness within 30 feet of you is dispelled, and each creature of your choice within 30 feet makes a Constitution saving throw. It takes 2d10 + your Cleric level Radiant damage on a failure, or half on a success.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to flash light at it and give the roll Disadvantage. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.description: Your Warding Flare uses come back after a Short or Long Rest. When you use it, the target of the attack gains 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: As a Magic action, you shine with sunlight for 1 minute: Bright Light in 60 feet and Dim Light 30 feet beyond. Enemies in the Bright Light have Disadvantage on saving throws against your Radiance of the Dawn and against spells that deal Fire or Radiant damage. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Trickery Domain
subclasses.summary: Make Mischief and Challenge Authority
subclasses.description: Trickery clerics serve gods of mischief. They sneak, fool and confuse, and fight beside a copy of themselves made of illusion.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility and Pass without Trace at level 3; Hypnotic Pattern and Nondetection at level 5; Confusion and Dimension Door at level 7; Dominate Person and Modify Memory at level 9.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: As a Magic action, pick yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet. It has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until you finish a Long Rest or use this again.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.description:
As a Bonus Action, spend a use of Channel Divinity to make a perfect illusion of yourself in an empty space within 30 feet. It lasts 1 minute.

Cast Spells. You can cast spells as if you were in the illusion's space, using your own senses.

Distract. When you and the illusion are both within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have Advantage on attack rolls against it.

Move. As a Bonus Action you can move the illusion up to 30 feet, to a space within 120 feet of you.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.description: When you take the Bonus Action to make or move your illusion, you can teleport and swap places with it.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: You and your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of your illusion. When the illusion ends, you or a creature of your choice within 5 feet of it regains Hit Points equal to your Cleric level.

subclasses.name: War Domain
subclasses.summary: Inspire Valor and Smite Foes
subclasses.description: War clerics serve gods of battle. They strike often, guide allies' blows and shrug off weapon hits.

features.name: War Domain Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith and Spiritual Weapon at level 3; Crusader's Mantle and Spirit Guardians at level 5; Fire Shield and Freedom of Movement at level 7; Hold Monster and Steel Wind Strike at level 9.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet misses with an attack roll, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to give that roll +10, which can turn the miss into a hit. Helping someone else uses your Reaction.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: You can spend a use of Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a spell slot. Cast this way, the spell needs no Concentration and lasts 1 minute.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

subclasses.name: Oath of Glory
subclasses.summary: Strive for the Heights of Heroism
subclasses.description: Glory paladins believe they are meant for great deeds. They train body and spirit and lift their allies with them.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Guiding Bolt and Heroism at level 3; Enhance Ability and Magic Weapon at level 5; Haste and Protection from Energy at level 9; Compulsion and Freedom of Movement at level 13; Legend Lore and Yolande's Regal Presence at level 17.

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.description: Right after you cast Divine Smite, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to hand out 2d8 + your Paladin level Temporary Hit Points, split as you like among creatures of your choice within 30 feet, yourself included.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a use of Channel Divinity. For 1 hour you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and your Long and High Jumps go 10 feet further.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.description: Your Speed goes up by 10 feet. When an ally enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, its Speed goes up by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.description: When you or a creature you can see within 10 feet is hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to add your Charisma modifier (at least +1) to the target's AC against it. If the attack then misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of this Reaction, if it is in range. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you become a living legend for 10 minutes. You have Advantage on Charisma checks. Once on each of your turns, when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make it hit instead. When you fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reroll it, and you must use the new roll. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 spell slot to do it again.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Ancients
subclasses.summary: Preserve Life and Light in the World
subclasses.description: Ancients paladins protect life, joy and nature. Green vines answer their call and old magic keeps them standing.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Ensnaring Strike and Speak with Animals at level 3; Misty Step and Moonbeam at level 5; Plant Growth and Protection from Energy at level 9; Ice Storm and Stoneskin at level 13; Commune with Nature and Tree Stride at level 17.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.description: As a Magic action, spend a use of Channel Divinity to call up ghostly vines. Each creature of your choice within 15 feet makes a Strength saving throw or is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: You and your allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: When you drop to 0 Hit Points and aren't killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead and regain Hit Points equal to three times your Paladin level. Once per Long Rest. You also stop aging and can't be aged by magic.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.description:
As a Bonus Action, you take the form of an ancient force of nature for 1 minute.

Diminish Defiance. Enemies in your Aura of Protection have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity.

Regeneration. You regain 10 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns.

Swift Spells. When you cast a spell that takes an action, you can cast it as a Bonus Action instead.

Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 spell slot to do it again.

subclasses.name: Oath of Vengeance
subclasses.summary: Punish Evildoers at Any Cost
subclasses.description: Vengeance paladins hunt those who do great evil. They mark one foe and chase it down without rest.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Bane and Hunter's Mark at level 3; Hold Person and Misty Step at level 5; Haste and Protection from Energy at level 9; Banishment and Dimension Door at level 13; Hold Monster and Scrying at level 17.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to swear a vow against a creature you can see within 30 feet. You have Advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until you use this again. If it drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can move the vow to another creature within 30 feet (no action needed).

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn. You can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction, without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: Right after the creature under your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make a melee attack against it, if it is in range.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.description:
As a Bonus Action, you take the form of an avenging angel for 10 minutes.

Flight. You sprout wings and have a Fly Speed of 60 feet; you can hover.

Frightful Aura. When an enemy starts its turn in your Aura of Protection, it makes a Wisdom saving throw or is Frightened of you for 1 minute or until it takes damage. Attack rolls against a creature Frightened this way have Advantage.

Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 spell slot to do it again.

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.summary: Bond with a Primal Beast
subclasses.description: Beast Masters fight beside a magical animal friend: a beast of the land, sea or sky that grows stronger with them.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description:
You summon a primal beast: a Beast of the Land, Sea or Sky. You can summon a different one after a Long Rest.

In Combat. The beast acts on your turn and takes the Dodge action unless you command it. As a Bonus Action you can command it to take an action from its stat block or another action. When you take the Attack action, you can give up one of your attacks to command it to take the Beast's Strike action. If you are Incapacitated it acts on its own.

Restore. If it died within the last hour, you can touch it, spend a spell slot and take a Magic action; it returns with full Hit Points after 1 minute.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: When you take the Bonus Action to command your beast, you can also have it take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help action as its Bonus Action. When it hits, it can deal Force damage instead of its usual type.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: When you command your beast to take the Beast's Strike action, it can make two attacks. The first time each turn it hits a creature under your Hunter's Mark, it deals extra Force damage equal to that spell's bonus damage.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: When you cast a spell that targets yourself, you can also make it affect your beast if it is within 30 feet of you.

Primal Companion.description: Pick the beast you summon. You can pick another after a Long Rest.

options.name: Beast of the Land
options.description: AC 13 + your Wisdom modifier. Hit Points 5 + five times your Ranger level. Speed 40 feet, Climb 40 feet. Beast's Strike: melee attack using your spell attack bonus, 1d8 + 2 + your Wisdom modifier Piercing damage. Charge: if it moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target first, the hit deals 1d6 extra damage and a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or falls Prone.

options.name: Beast of the Sea
options.description: AC 13 + your Wisdom modifier. Hit Points 5 + five times your Ranger level. Speed 5 feet, Swim 60 feet; breathes air and water. Beast's Strike: melee attack using your spell attack bonus, 1d6 + 2 + your Wisdom modifier Bludgeoning or Piercing damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC equals your spell save DC).

options.name: Beast of the Sky
options.description: AC 13 + your Wisdom modifier. Hit Points 4 + four times your Ranger level. Speed 10 feet, Fly 60 feet; it doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of reach. Beast's Strike: melee attack using your spell attack bonus, 1d4 + 3 + your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage.

subclasses.name: Fey Wanderer
subclasses.summary: Wield Fey Mirth and Fury
subclasses.description: Fey Wanderers carry a touch of the Feywild. Their strikes hurt the mind, their charm wins friends, and fey spirits come to help.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Charm Person at level 3, Misty Step at level 5, Summon Fey at level 9, Dimension Door at level 13 and Mislead at level 17. You also gain a harmless fey trinket or mark of your choice.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage. Each creature can take this extra damage only once per turn. The die becomes 1d6 at Ranger level 11.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.description: When you make a Charisma check, add your Wisdom modifier (at least +1) to it. You also gain proficiency in one skill of your choice: Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition. When you or a creature you can see within 120 feet succeeds on such a save, you can take a Reaction to make a different creature you can see within 120 feet make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure it is Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: You can cast Summon Fey without a Material component. Once per Long Rest you can cast it without a spell slot. When you cast it, you can choose to need no Concentration; the spell then lasts 1 minute.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.description: You can cast Misty Step without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest. When you cast it, you can bring one willing creature within 5 feet of you. It teleports to an empty space of your choice within 5 feet of where you arrive.

Otherworldly Glamour.description: Pick one skill to become proficient in.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker
subclasses.summary: Draw on Shadow Magic to Fight Your Foes
subclasses.description: Gloom Stalkers hunt in the dark. They strike first, vanish from creatures that see in the dark, and fill enemies with dread.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Disguise Self at level 3, Rope Trick at level 5, Fear at level 9, Greater Invisibility at level 13 and Seeming at level 17.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description:
Ambusher's Leap. At the start of your first turn of each combat, your Speed goes up by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

Dreadful Strike. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage. Once per turn, a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest.

Initiative Bonus. Add your Wisdom modifier to your Initiative rolls.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: You gain Darkvision 60 feet, or 60 more feet if you already have it. While you are entirely in Darkness, you are Invisible to any creature that relies on Darkvision to see you there.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have it, pick Intelligence or Charisma saving throws instead.

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description:
Your Dreadful Strike now deals 2d8 Psychic damage. When you use it, pick one extra effect.

Sudden Strike. You can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the first one and within the weapon's range.

Mass Fear. The target and each creature within 10 feet of it make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC, or are Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can take a Reaction to give that roll Disadvantage. Hit or miss, you can then teleport up to 30 feet to an empty space you can see.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.summary: Adopt Animal Forms to Guard the Wilds
subclasses.description: Moon druids live in their Wild Shape forms. They turn into tougher beasts than other druids and fight on the front line with moonlight on their side.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Cure Wounds, Moonbeam and Starry Wisp at level 3; Conjure Animals at level 5; Fount of Moonlight at level 7; Mass Cure Wounds at level 9. You can cast these spells while in Wild Shape.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description:
Your Wild Shape is stronger.

Challenge Rating. You can turn into a Beast with a Challenge Rating up to your Druid level divided by 3, rounded down.

Armor Class. In beast form your AC is at least 13 + your Wisdom modifier.

Temporary Hit Points. When you take a Wild Shape form you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to three times your Druid level.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.description: While in Wild Shape, your attacks can deal Radiant damage instead of their usual type, and you add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saving throws.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.description: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet to an empty space you can see, and you have Advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of this turn. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest, or spend a level 2+ spell slot to get one back.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.description: Once per turn, when you hit with an attack in Wild Shape, you can deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage. When you use Moonlight Step, you can also teleport one willing creature within 10 feet of you to an empty space within 10 feet of where you arrive.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Sea
subclasses.summary: Become One with Tides and Storms
subclasses.description: Sea druids carry the ocean with them. A cloud of stormy spray surrounds them, freezing and shoving enemies away.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter and Thunderwave at level 3; Lightning Bolt and Water Breathing at level 5; Control Water and Ice Storm at level 7; Conjure Elemental and Hold Monster at level 9.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a use of Wild Shape to wrap yourself in ocean spray: a 5-foot Emanation for 10 minutes. When it appears, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, pick a creature you can see in it. It makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure it takes Cold damage equal to a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least one), and a Large or smaller creature is pushed up to 15 feet away from you. It ends early if you are Incapacitated, dismiss it or use it again.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: Your Wrath of the Sea grows to 10 feet, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: While your Wrath of the Sea is active, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning and Thunder damage.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.description: Instead of around yourself, you can wrap your Wrath of the Sea around one willing creature within 60 feet. It gets the benefits and uses your spell save DC and Wisdom. Spend two uses of Wild Shape to wrap it around both of you.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Stars
subclasses.summary: Harness Secrets Hidden in Constellations
subclasses.description: Star druids read the night sky. Instead of a beast they take a glowing starry form that shoots light, heals friends or steadies the mind.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: You have a star chart as your Spellcasting Focus. You always have Guidance and Guiding Bolt prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description:
As a Bonus Action, spend a use of Wild Shape to take a starry form for 10 minutes instead of turning into a beast. You shed Bright Light in 10 feet and Dim Light 10 feet beyond. Pick a constellation.

Archer. When you take the form, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, make a ranged spell attack at a creature within 60 feet: 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Radiant damage on a hit.

Chalice. When you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points, you or another creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Hit Points.

Dragon. On an Intelligence or Wisdom check, or a Constitution save to keep Concentration, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: After a Long Rest, roll any die. On an even number you get Weal, on an odd number Woe. When a creature you can see within 30 feet is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll a d6: with Weal it adds the number, with Woe it subtracts it. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: Archer and Chalice use 2d8 instead of 1d8. In the Dragon form you also have a Fly Speed of 20 feet and can hover. At the start of each of your turns in Starry Form you can switch constellations.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: While in Starry Form, you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

subclasses.name: Aberrant Sorcery
subclasses.summary: Wield Unnatural Psionic Power
subclasses.description: Aberrant sorcerers were touched by a strange being from beyond. They speak mind to mind, cast with pure thought and can twist their bodies.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers and Mind Sliver at level 3; Hunger of Hadar and Sending at level 5; Black Tentacles and Summon Aberration at level 7; Telepathic Bond and Telekinesis at level 9. When you gain a Sorcerer level you can swap one of them for another Divination or Enchantment spell of the same level from the Sorcerer list.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: As a Bonus Action, pick a creature you can see within 30 feet. You and it can speak mind to mind for a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level, while within a number of miles equal to your Charisma modifier (at least 1). You both need to know a language.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: When you cast a level 1+ spell from your Psionic Spells, you can spend Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level instead of a spell slot. Cast this way, it needs no Verbal or Somatic components, and no Material ones unless they are used up or have a cost.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description:
As a Bonus Action, spend 1 or more Sorcery Points. For 10 minutes you gain one benefit per point spent.

Aquatic Adaptation. A Swim Speed of twice your Speed, and you can breathe underwater.

Glistening Flight. A Fly Speed equal to your Speed, and you can hover.

See the Invisible. You see Invisible creatures within 60 feet.

Wormlike Movement. You can squeeze through a 1-inch gap, and you can spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints or a grapple.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: As a Magic action, teleport to an empty space you can see within 120 feet. Each creature within 30 feet of the space you left makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure it takes 3d10 Force damage and is pulled straight toward that space; on a success it takes half damage. Once per Long Rest, or spend 5 Sorcery Points to do it again.

subclasses.name: Clockwork Sorcery
subclasses.summary: Channel Cosmic Forces of Order
subclasses.description: Clockwork sorcerers carry the magic of perfect order. They cancel lucky and unlucky rolls, shield friends and set things right.

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration and Protection from Evil and Good at level 3; Dispel Magic and Protection from Energy at level 5; Freedom of Movement and Summon Construct at level 7; Greater Restoration and Wall of Force at level 9. When you gain a Sorcerer level you can swap one of them for another Abjuration or Transmutation spell of the same level from the Sorcerer list. A small sign of order also marks you, such as ticking sounds or gear-shaped eyes.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage, you can take a Reaction to cancel the Advantage or Disadvantage for that roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 1 to 5 Sorcery Points to put a ward on yourself or a creature within 30 feet. The ward holds that many d8s. When the warded creature takes damage, it can spend any of those dice, roll them and reduce the damage by the total. The ward lasts until you finish a Long Rest or use this again.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: As a Bonus Action, enter a state of order for 1 minute. Attack rolls against you can't have Advantage, and when you make a D20 Test you can treat a roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Once per Long Rest, or spend 5 Sorcery Points to do it again.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.description:
As a Magic action, call up spirits of order in a 30-foot Cube from you, choosing any of these.

Heal. Restore up to 100 Hit Points, split as you like among creatures of your choice in the Cube.

Repair. Damaged objects entirely in the Cube are fixed at once.

Dispel. Every spell of level 6 or lower ends on creatures and objects of your choice in the Cube.

Once per Long Rest, or spend 7 Sorcery Points to do it again.

subclasses.name: Wild Magic Sorcery
subclasses.summary: Unleash Chaos as Magic
subclasses.description: Wild Magic sorcerers carry raw chaos. Their spells sometimes cause random surges, and they bend luck for themselves and others.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Once per turn, right after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, you can roll a d20. On a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook to create a random effect. A surge that is a spell can't be changed with Metamagic.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Before you make a D20 Test, you can give yourself Advantage on it. Once used, the next time you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot before a Long Rest, you automatically roll on the Wild Magic Surge table and get this use back. Otherwise once per Long Rest.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: When another creature you can see makes a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction and spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll a d4 and add it to or subtract it from that roll. You can do this after seeing the roll but before its result is known.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and use either result.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.description: Right after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, you can pick any effect from the Wild Magic Surge table instead of rolling, except the table's last row. Once per Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Archfey Patron
subclasses.summary: Bargain with Whimsical Fey
subclasses.description: Archfey warlocks serve a lord or lady of the fey. They blink from place to place, leaving tricks and terror behind.

features.name: Archfey Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Calm Emotions, Faerie Fire, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force and Sleep at level 3; Blink and Plant Growth at level 5; Dominate Beast and Greater Invisibility at level 7; Dominate Person and Seeming at level 9.

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.description:
You can cast Misty Step without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (at least once); uses come back after a Long Rest. When you cast it, pick one extra effect.

Refreshing Step. You or a creature you can see within 10 feet gains 1d10 Temporary Hit Points.

Taunting Step. Creatures within 5 feet of the space you left make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description:
You can cast Misty Step as a Reaction when you take damage. Steps of the Fey gains two more choices.

Disappearing Step. You are Invisible until the start of your next turn, or until right after you attack, deal damage or cast a spell.

Dreadful Step. Creatures within 5 feet of the space you left or arrive in (your pick) make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or take 2d10 Psychic damage.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: You are immune to the Charmed condition. Right after a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the damage you take (round down). The attacker makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC, taking Psychic damage equal to the damage you took on a failure. Once per Long Rest, or spend a Pact Magic slot to do it again.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.description: Right after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell that takes an action and uses a spell slot, you can cast Misty Step as part of the same action without a spell slot.

subclasses.name: Celestial Patron
subclasses.summary: Call on the Power of the Heavens
subclasses.description: Celestial warlocks serve a being of the Upper Planes. They heal friends with radiant light and burn enemies with holy fire.

features.name: Celestial Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light and Sacred Flame at level 3; Daylight and Revivify at level 5; Guardian of Faith and Wall of Fire at level 7; Greater Restoration and Summon Celestial at level 9.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: You have a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your Warlock level. As a Bonus Action, heal a creature you can see within 60 feet: spend dice from the pool, up to your Charisma modifier (at least one), roll them and restore that many Hit Points. The pool refills after a Long Rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: You have Resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant or Fire damage, add your Charisma modifier to that damage against one of its targets.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: When you use Magical Cunning or finish a Short or Long Rest, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Warlock level + your Charisma modifier. Up to five creatures of your choice that you can see also gain half your Warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: When you or an ally within 60 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, you can unleash radiant energy instead. That creature regains Hit Points equal to half its Hit Point maximum and can stand up from Prone. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of it takes 2d8 + your Charisma modifier Radiant damage and is Blinded until the end of the turn. Once per Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Great Old One Patron
subclasses.summary: Unearth Forbidden Lore of Unknowable Beings
subclasses.description: These warlocks serve a vast and alien mind. They speak through thoughts, hurt minds instead of bodies and see through their enemies.

features.name: Great Old One Spells
features.description: You always have these spells prepared: Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Phantasmal Force and Hideous Laughter at level 3; Clairvoyance and Hunger of Hadar at level 5; Confusion and Summon Aberration at level 7; Modify Memory and Telekinesis at level 9.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: As a Bonus Action, link minds with a creature you can see within 30 feet. You can speak mind to mind for a number of minutes equal to your Warlock level, while within a number of miles equal to your Charisma modifier (at least 1). You both need to know a language.

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.description: When you cast a Warlock spell that deals damage, you can change its damage type to Psychic. You can cast Warlock Enchantment and Illusion spells without Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.description: When you link minds with Awakened Mind, you can make the creature make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, while the link lasts it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you and you have Advantage on attack rolls against it. Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a Pact Magic slot to do it again.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.description: You always have Hex prepared. When you cast it and pick an ability, the target also has Disadvantage on saving throws with that ability while the spell lasts.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it. You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and a creature that deals Psychic damage to you takes the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: When you cast Summon Aberration, you can make it need no Concentration; it then lasts 1 minute. The aberration gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Warlock level + your Charisma modifier. The first time each turn it hits a creature under your Hex, it deals extra Psychic damage equal to Hex's bonus damage.

subclasses.name: Abjurer
subclasses.summary: Shield Companions and Banish Foes
subclasses.description: Abjurers master protective magic. A magical ward soaks up hits for them and their friends, and they break other casters' spells.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Pick two Wizard spells of the Abjuration school, each level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Each time you gain access to a new level of spell slots, add one Abjuration spell of that level to your spellbook for free.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: When you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, you can create a magical ward on yourself that lasts until you finish a Long Rest. Its Hit Point maximum is twice your Wizard level + your Intelligence modifier. When you take damage, the ward takes it first. Each time you cast an Abjuration spell with a slot, the ward regains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's level. As a Bonus Action you can spend a spell slot to restore twice the slot's level instead.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, you can take a Reaction to have your Arcane Ward take that damage instead.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.description: You always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared. You can cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action and add your Proficiency Bonus to its ability check. When you cast either with a spell slot and it fails to stop a spell, the slot isn't used up.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and Resistance to the damage of spells.

subclasses.name: Diviner
subclasses.summary: Learn the Secrets of the Multiverse
subclasses.description: Diviners see glimpses of the future. Each day they foresee a few dice rolls and can swap them in for anyone's roll.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Pick two Wizard spells of the Divination school, each level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Each time you gain access to a new level of spell slots, add one Divination spell of that level to your spellbook for free.

features.name: Portent
features.description: After a Long Rest, roll two d20s and write down the numbers. You can replace any D20 Test made by you or a creature you can see with one of these rolls; decide before the roll. Each foretold roll can be used once, and you can use this once per turn. Unused rolls are lost at your next Long Rest.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: When you cast a Divination spell of level 2 or higher with a spell slot, you regain one spent spell slot of a lower level than that spell, no higher than level 5.

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description:
As a Bonus Action, pick one benefit that lasts until you start a Short or Long Rest.

Darkvision. You gain Darkvision 120 feet.

Greater Comprehension. You can read any language.

See Invisibility. You can cast See Invisibility without a spell slot.

Once per Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: You roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.

subclasses.name: Illusionist
subclasses.summary: Weave Subtle Spells of Deception
subclasses.description: Illusionists fool the senses. Their illusions reach farther, need no words, and at high level can even become real for a moment.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Pick two Wizard spells of the Illusion school, each level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Each time you gain access to a new level of spell slots, add one Illusion spell of that level to your spellbook for free.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.description: You can cast Illusion spells without Verbal components, and Illusion spells with a range of 10 feet or more get 60 feet more range. You know Minor Illusion without it counting against your cantrips; you can make both a sound and an image with one casting, and cast it as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.description: You always have Summon Beast and Summon Fey prepared. When you cast either, you can make it an Illusion spell so the creature looks ghostly. Once per Long Rest each, you can cast that illusion version without a spell slot; the creature then has half its usual Hit Points.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to put an illusory copy of yourself in the way; the attack misses. Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a level 2+ spell slot to do it again.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: When you cast an Illusion spell with a spell slot, you can use a Bonus Action while it lasts to make one inanimate, nonmagical object in the illusion real for 1 minute. The object can't deal damage or cause conditions.
